item.description: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Ollama. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The ZDI has assigned a CVSS rating of 7.5.

item.title: [HIGH] ZDI-26-402: (0Day) Glarysoft Glary Utilities Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
item.description: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Glarysoft Glary Utilities. item.title: [LOW] RedWing MaaS Packages Android Bank Fraud as a Telegram Rental Service
item.description: A new Android malware operation called RedWing is being rented out on Telegram as a ready-made bank-fraud service. It lets even low-skill criminals take over a victim's phone, steal their banking logins, and capture the one-time codes that protect their accounts. Zimperium's zLabs, which found the operation, says it looks like a new variant of Oblivion, a $300-a-month rent-a-malware tool
